article_asking_questions_in_class.summary: A good question is a small key that opens a big door. After reading this you can ask a clear question in class, use the right question words, wait for your turn, and ask a teacher or grown-up for help politely.
article_asking_questions_in_class.title: Asking Questions in the Classroom

article_credit_cards.summary: A credit card is a loan with a billing cycle attached. After reading this you can work out what a balance really costs, why the minimum payment takes years to clear, which card traps cost the most, and what to say when you call your bank.
article_credit_cards.title: Understanding Credit Cards and Interest Rates

article_science_sleepneed.summary: Sleep is not wasted time. While you sleep your body repairs itself, your brain sorts what you learned, and your body clock resets for the next day. After reading this you can explain what sleep is for, say how many hours children need, name what happens to your body and brain at night, and build a bedtime routine that works.
article_science_sleepneed.title: Why Do We Need Sleep?

article_sun_moon_stars.summary: The sky is full of lights, but they are not all the same kind of thing. After reading this, you can say what the Sun, the Moon and a star each are, explain why the Moon seems to change shape, and find real stars in the night sky without a telescope.
article_sun_moon_stars.title: The Sun, the Moon, and the Stars

article_workplace_expressions.summary: Every workplace has a layer of language that is not in the dictionary: phrases for a meeting, a delay, a mistake, a decision. After reading this you will understand the expressions you hear in offices, use them at the right moment, and avoid the ones that make you sound either too casual or too managerial.
article_workplace_expressions.title: Understanding Common Workplace Expressions
